description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Merfolk Secretkeeper, adding {U}.
Cast Venture Deeper for its flashback cost by paying {U}, causing target player to mill four cards, then exile Merfolk Secretkeeper.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bat token, adding {U}.
Cast Merfolk Secretkeeper from exile by paying {U}.
Repeat.
